### New

- **Velta Circle — group audio calls (beta).** In a group, attach menu → **Group call**. The call appears in the chat as a card (name, who started it, who is in it, Join / Open) instead of ringing, and an in-call bar stays on top while you use the app. Up to 6 people talk at once; audio goes directly between participants and always through the relay's TURN servers, so nobody sees your IP address. When everyone leaves, the card shows "Call ended · duration" and **Start again**. Opened in Delta Chat, it shows who is in the call and "Open in Velta to join".
- **Video calls** in single chats (header icon on wide screens, ⋮ → Video call on phones): turn the camera on and off during any call and switch front/back camera on phones. Works with Delta Chat.
- **Calls in the browser app**, with a TURN fallback for relays that publish a hostname.
- **Background Web Push in the browser app:** Push notifications → "Notify me when Velta is closed" gives a generic "New message" notification while Velta is closed (iPhone/iPad: iOS 16.4+, added to the Home Screen).
- **velta.cc/web**: the browser app is published there automatically.
- **Velta Beam and Velta Circle follow the Velta design system** in dark and light. Opened outside Velta they show one quiet "velta.cc" line — never a popup.

### Fixes

- **Calls send your microphone again**, start on the earpiece (speaker toggle on phones), and the microphone/camera permission is checked and asked for before it is needed, instead of failing silently.
- **Messages stalled after turning a VPN on or off.** Velta now resumes syncing when the network changes, with a safety net if a change is missed.
- **Readable everywhere:** an app-wide contrast pass brings all text to WCAG AA in dark, light and brutal themes and with custom accents.
- **Mini-app cards:** the Start button no longer covers the app's summary.
- **Mini-apps can no longer use the microphone, camera, screen or location** on any platform.

### Under the hood

- Chatmail core **2.64.0**. Its database upgrade is one-way: back up before upgrading if you might go back to an older Velta.
- The old `velta-core-service` background APK is archived.
